title: Kanthapura

vibeProfile.oneLine: Gandhi's movement transforms a South Indian village, told village-style.

summary: Told in the breathless voice of an old village woman, Kanthapura recounts how the Gandhian independence movement reaches a small South Indian village and transforms it, stirring its people to non-violent resistance against colonial and caste injustice. Raja Rao's novel is famous for bending English to the rhythms of Indian oral storytelling, folding myth, gossip and politics into a single flowing narrative. A foundational work of Indian English fiction and a vivid portrait of the freedom struggle from the ground up.
whyReadIt: The freedom struggle reaching one village, told in the rhythms of Indian oral storytelling. A foundational Indian novel.

funFacts.text: Raja Rao's preface, on writing English in an Indian idiom, is a landmark statement of Indian English literature.
